name: Chicken Shawarma Lettuce Wraps with Avocado & Lemon-Garlic Mayo

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 lemon
2 tomatoes
1 avocado
1 head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the spice rub.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp coriander, ground
1 tsp turmeric, ground
salt
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice rub.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken breast dry with paper towels and cut into thin strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions and chicken; cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic, then add mayo, oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
extra virgin olive oil
salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice.
To serve, separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with chicken, tomato, and avocado. Drizzle with lemon-garlic mayo and enjoy!
